extracted.intended_audience: clients, potential clients, and legal professionals interested in patent litigation trends
extracted.subtask_description: Short press-release style summary highlighting a law firm's placement in Lex Machina's 2024 Patent Litigation Report, noting rankings by case volume and practice-side (plaintiff/defense) activity. Intended to publicize the firm's standing and experience in Delaware patent litigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Top ten law firms by district court cases filed
rubrics_metrics.description: Lex Machina’s lists of top ten law firms by district court cases filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a ranking metric in the Lex Machina report; the page cites firm placement on these lists (Morris Nichols #6 for plaintiff-side work and #4 for defense-side representations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Practice-side (plaintiff vs. defense) ranking
rubrics_metrics.description: Separate ranking/listings for plaintiff-side work and defense-side representations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report distinguishes firm activity by side of litigation (plaintiff-side and defense-side), allowing firms to be ranked differently on each list (example: same firm appears on both sides with different ranks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Three-year analysis window
rubrics_metrics.description: Analyzing US patent litigation trends over a three-year period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report aggregates and assesses patent litigation activity across a specified three-year timeframe; rankings and trend observations are based on that multi-year window.
